Golden Week is about to start in Japan and so Steam will once again be holding a Golden Week Sale.

The title has overwhelmingly positive reviews so far following in the steps of the previous title from Team ladybug, Touhou Luna Nights.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203630/

That's not all!

Your average everyday deer game, DEEEER Simulator 20% off
Extend your neck and hook onto stuff with your antlers, swing about town and enjoy your deer life.

Recent updates include a Dog police officer and a collaboration with I am Bread which introduces a toaster which transforms your deer into a slice of bread.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018800/_DEEEER_Simulator/

Orangeblood 25% off
WELCOME TO NEW KOZA

JRPG with random loot drops!

A near infinite combination of stats and effects for weapon drops.
Mix and match your loadouts to draw out the full potential of your gear.
The utterly dope soundtrack, containing 12 tracks produced by developer Grayfax Software, is also available on sale. Overflowing with 90s Hip Hop vibes, this is a great opportunity to pick it up bundled with the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042670/Orangeblood/

https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Playism/list/51161

notes.title: [Notice] Cheru leaving Playism
notes.content:
Hi All 

This is a general notice to all Playism titles. 
From June 14th onwards, I (Cheru) will no longer be Playism's community manager. After over 4 years of working passionately in Playism, I have decided to leave and change direction. I am sad that I won't be working and playing with you all as a member of Playism anymore, however, I will still be around on Steam.

Thank you everyone for the amazing communities you have built around Playism games and I hope that you will all continue to enjoy their games for years to come. 

- Cheru

notes.title: As of today the Italian version of Alicemare is available to play!
notes.content:
To play the Italian version:

    Right-click the game in your Steam library > Properties > LANGUAGE > Select 'Italian' from the dropdown box
    Note that if you have existing save data you must delete it first
    To delete your data start the game > Right-click on the game in your Steam library > Properties > LOCAL FILES > BROWSE LOCAL FILES > Save > Delete the files in this folder. This must be done while the game is open and idling on the title screen
    If your Windows Region setting is not set to "Italian (Italy)" you may experience text boxes overflow
    To change your region open Control Panel > Region > Administrative Settings > Change System Locale > Select "Italian (Italy)" > OK > Restart Now


Please enjoy your time with this sweet, ineffably cruel game once again -- in Italian.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/524850/Alicemare/

notes.title: [Playism News] Angels of Death Out Now!
notes.content:
To all fans of 2D Horror Adventure games, today Playism has released "Angels of Death" on Playism and Steam! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/537110/

From the creator of the famous horror game "Kirisame ga furu mori" (Forest of Drizzling Rain), comes "Angels of Death" which was released in the Den-fami Nico Game Magazine and is now available worldwide! 
"Angels of Death" is a psycho horror adventure game, which consists of four episodes. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27040821/845b964cb8d9038287c1684734feeaf126fd4806.jpg

When Ray woke, she was in a concrete room with no memory. After leaving the room, she explored the building, searching for an exit. But she eventually crossed paths with Zack, a murderer whose face is bandaged and bears a resemblance to the Grim Reaper. 

"Please – kill me." 
"If you help me get outta here, then I'll kill you." 

The two formed a peculiar bond through their strange "promise" and started to search for an exit to the sealed building together. 
What kind of hell have they found themselves in? For what purpose are they imprisoned? What does fate have in store for them? 

You can get Angels of Death on Steam and Playism!

We hope you enjoy this tragically beautiful story about a murderer who wants to kill and a girl who wishes to be killed.

notes.title: Alicemare coming soon to Steam
notes.content:
Down the rabbit hole.... 




From the creator of LiEat comes Alicemare, a dark horror-esque game is coming soon to Steam. 

Allen has arrived at a special facility, with no memories or parents, he soon meets a variety of different children, each with their own story to tell. 

After investigating a strange rumor he heard from the other kids, Allen stumbles down the rabbit hole into a strange world.


Alicemare is coming soon! 


http://store.steampowered.com/app/524850


Can't wait? Be sure to check out LiEat on Steam too. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/373770/
